d:
Saee pallavi aksar apni sadgi ki vajah se charcha men rahi hain. kabhi bina mekaap vale philmi rol ke lie, kabhi chehre ke munhason par die bayan ki vajah se.
Aur ab saee pallavi ramayan philm men sita ke kirdar ki vajah se charcha men hain. janie kaun hain saee pallavi aur vo bina mekaap vale kirdaron, apni chois par kya boli thin?
